scope: T186 real-profile query execution through multi-widget Superset import, PostgreSQL reconciliation, and restart restoration

generation.instruction: Return patient_id, result_value, result_unit, and observed_at for the ten latest rows from analytics.lab_result_fact_v1.

writer.sql: SELECT patient_id, result_value, result_unit, observed_at FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1 ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 10

manualExecution.edit: LIMIT 10 changed to LIMIT 5 in the sole visible SQL editor
manualExecution.sql:
SELECT patient_id, result_value, result_unit, observed_at
FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1
ORDER BY observed_at DESC
LIMIT 5

postgresqlReconciliation.observedInSuperset: The rendered table displayed all five patient/value/unit/time rows.
postgresqlReconciliation.verificationSql: SELECT patient_id, result_value, result_unit, observed_at FROM (SELECT patient_id, result_value, result_unit, observed_at FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1 ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 5) AS dataset ORDER BY patient_id;

postgresqlReconciliation.observedInSuperset: The rendered line chart and View-as-table surface showed the patient/unit series at 2026-04-27 13:00:00; Superset's visible generated SQL grouped by time, patient, and unit.
postgresqlReconciliation.verificationSql: SELECT observed_at, patient_id, result_unit, MAX(result_value) FROM (SELECT patient_id, result_value, result_unit, observed_at FROM analytics.lab_result_fact_v1 ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 5) AS virtual_table GROUP BY observed_at, patient_id, result_unit ORDER BY MAX(result_value) DESC;
postgresqlReconciliation.metricInterpretation: MAX is a Superset-native metric required to plot the already-defined result table. It is not a Catalyst aggregation choice and does not rewrite the Dataset SQL.

nondeterminismAndOpenIssues: Only one identical-input model run was performed. Temperature zero and dry multiplier zero are recorded but reproducibility is not assumed; repetition remains T187.

The generated ORDER BY observed_at DESC has no stable secondary key. Because all five selected rows share the same observed_at, the SQL-standard choice among tied rows is nondeterministic even though this run and restart retained the recorded execution.

The chart exporter derives Superset's required native metric and groups by every available categorical column. A dataset lacking a unique series dimension may still collapse duplicate time/series rows; the MVP does not expose a second aggregation selector.
The non-destructive restart preserved all state but HAPI and OpenELIS JVM startup took several minutes. No FHIR download, seed, or volume reset occurred.
The complete T187 failure/recovery, repetition, accessibility, durable screenshot/video, and schema-backed acceptance matrix remains open.
